AAPL.rationale: Apple's franchise is among the most durable in global equities — 2.35B active devices, Services at $96B with ~75% gross margins, and $851B cumulative buybacks mechanically boosting EPS. Q2 FY2026 showed genuine YoY momentum: revenue +16.6%, EPS +21.8%, gross margin expanding to 49.3% from 47.0%. However, the stock at 38.6x trailing PE (per quant pack) is priced for near-flawless execution in a challenging macro environment — the 10-year Treasury yield at 4.71% sits 210bps above the 2.6% earnings yield, and the yield curve is flattening. The recent 17.8% quarterly rally has already re-rated PE from ~32x trough to 38.6x, compressing margin of safety. Material near-term headwinds include: BofA's margin compression forecast (gross margins to 34.1% in Q4 2026 from rising memory costs), the CEO transition from Cook to Ternus on Sep 1 introducing execution uncertainty, and DOJ antitrust settlement talks threatening App Store economics. The July 30 earnings report is a critical catalyst — Q3 guidance of 14-17% revenue growth and ~48% gross margin will test whether the margin trajectory holds. China AI approval (Jul 16) and the Klarna leasing program (Jul 28) are positive but already partially priced in. Net: excellent business, fair-to-slightly-rich valuation, with a near-term binary event (earnings) that could go either way on margins. Score reflects strong franchise quality partially offset by stretched valuation and genuine near-term uncertainty.
